$comment: Canonical Dashboard_View grid composition shared by BOTH clients (Requirement 13.1).
The Dashboard_View is built by each client independently — the Mobile_Client
(Dart, flutter_app/lib/ui/dashboard/dashboard_view.dart) and the Web_Client
(TypeScript, react_app/src/screens/DashboardView.tsx) — because a Dart file
cannot import a TypeScript file and vice versa. Both derive the composition
as data: a single ordered List<Grid12Cell> built from the Layout_Mode, not
branching layout code (design.md, Dashboard composition). That per-client
duplication can silently drift, so this file is the referee. It records the
expected ordered cells and their column spans once, at the repo root outside
both client trees, and each client's Property 29 suite asserts its own
composition equals this array exactly, in order, including spans. A
divergence between the clients cannot pass because both read this same file.
Read by (Property 29 tests, task 9.14 — not yet written):
- react_app/src/__tests__/compliance/composition-examples.node.test.ts
- flutter_app/test/compliance/composition_examples_test.dart
Reader shape contract (keep stable so both clients parse identically):
modes: object keyed by Layout_Mode name ('compact' | 'medium' | 'expanded').
Each mode has:
grid    (bool)  — true when the mode renders the Grid_12 Dashboard_View,
false when it renders the Sensor_Carousel instead.
cells   (array) — ordered cells, each { role, span } where span is the
Grid_12 column span (1..12). Present and non-empty only
when grid is true; an empty array when grid is false.
note    (string, optional) — human-readable explanation for grid:false.
role values are stable identifiers, not display text:
'kpi-main-inlet' | 'kpi-outlet-a' | 'kpi-outlet-b' | 'main-chart' | 'alerts-panel'.
Compact is documented explicitly as carousel-only (grid:false, cells:[]).
design.md maps only Medium and Expanded to the Dashboard_View; Compact
resolves to the Sensor_Carousel and has no Grid_12 composition. Property 29
ranges over the three Layout_Modes read from this file, so Compact is present
as a mode whose asserted composition is 'no grid composition' — a client that
wrongly builds a grid in Compact fails against grid:false.
Span arithmetic (Requirement 2.2, Grid_12): every run of cells sums to 12.
expanded: 4+4+4 = 12 (KPI_Row run), then 8+4 = 12 (chart + alerts run).
medium:   4+4+4 = 12 (KPI_Row run), then 12 (chart), then 12 (alerts).
KPI cell order is fixed: Main Inlet, Outlet A, Outlet B (Requirement 3.2).

compact.note: Compact renders the Sensor_Carousel, not the Grid_12 Dashboard_View. No grid composition.
